existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Custodian must provide a cost estimate
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: With its timely response, the custodian must provide the requester an estimate of the expected cost of the copies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: the custodian of such record shall provide to the requester ... an estimate of the expected cost of the copies
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: The estimate starts the requester's ten-business-day review window (NE-0015).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Copy fee capped at actual added cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A custodian may charge a fee for providing copies, but the fee shall not exceed the actual added cost of making the copies available.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Custodian produces copies for the requester.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: the public body, public entity, or public official which is the custodian of a public record may charge a fee for providing copies of such public record ... which fee shall not exceed the actual added cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.effective_status: Current (fee limits tightened by 2024 Neb. Laws LB 43)
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Ceiling of 'actual added cost'; no statewide per-page cents rate — the municipality supplies the operative rate under the ceiling.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: First eight cumulative hours of labor not chargeable to residents
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For a Nebraska resident's request, the actual added cost used to calculate a fee shall not include any charge for existing salary/pay obligations for the first eight cumulative hours of searching, identifying, physically redacting, or copying.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester is a resident; labor total is within the first eight cumulative hours.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: the actual added cost used as the basis for the calculation of a fee for records shall not include any charge for the existing salary or pay obligation to the public officers or employees with respect to the first eight cumulative hours of searching, identifying, physically redacting, or copying
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Fixed free-labor allowance of eight cumulative hours for residents; labor beyond eight hours may be recovered as a special service charge (referenced in the cost-review clause, NE-0015).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Deposit may be required when estimated cost exceeds fifty dollars
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If the estimated cost of requested copies exceeds fifty dollars, the custodian may require the requester to furnish a deposit before fulfilling the request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If copies requested ... are estimated by the custodian of such public records to cost more than fifty dollars, the custodian may require the requester to furnish a deposit prior to fulfilling such request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: The $50 trigger threshold is fixed by statute; the deposit amount itself is discretionary within the actual-cost ceiling.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Discretionary fee waiver or reduction in the public interest
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The custodian may waive or reduce any fee if the waiver or reduction would be in the public interest.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Custodian determines waiver/reduction is in the public interest.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The custodian may waive or reduce any fee described in this section if the waiver or reduction of the fee would be in the public interest.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Discretionary; no numeric standard, so config_home is structural.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Reasonable fee for modem/electronic transmission of county records
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: When a county custodian provides a copy by transmitting it modem-to-modem, a reasonable fee may be charged for the specialized service, which may include a reasonable amortization of added computer equipment/software cost.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Record delivered by modem-to-modem transmission by a county custodian.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: When a custodian of a public record of a county provides to a member of the public, upon request, a copy of the public record by transmitting it from a modem to an outside modem, a reasonable fee may be charged for such specialized service. Such fee may include a reasonable amount representing a portion of the amortization of the cost of computer equipment, including software, necessarily added in order to provide such specialized service.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: 'Reasonable fee' is a soft-standard value; text is county-specific.
